releaseNotes:
CantosTV v1.5.5

- Live TV: pressing Back in the channel list now goes back to the folders instead of closing the whole panel.
- Live TV: leaving the app while watching and coming back now re-syncs to live instantly, like a regular TV.
- Movies & Series: if the stream drops and reconnects, it now resumes where you were instead of restarting from the beginning.
- Player: while dragging the progress bar to seek, a time bubble now shows the exact spot you're scrubbing to.
